text: 火没有把外面的生物吓走，反而像灯塔一样将它们引来。树枝和褐色松针铺成的地面响起它们古怪的脚步声，奇异的影子沿洞壁滑过。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 329
text: Instead of repelling the creatures out there, the fire serves as a beacon to bring them in. The mat of twigs and brown pine needles rustles with their strange tread. Odd shadows slip along the cave walls.
